# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships (reporting line not stated) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s partner motion sits at the intersection of frontier-model access and enterprise implementation. Its public partner network spans cloud, technology, and services firms, while its enterprise materials frame adoption as a
multi-phase operating change rather than a simple software rollout.

The operating tension is turning a safety- and reliability-led AI product into repeatable, partner-delivered business outcomes without allowing solution variation, weak governance, or uneven technical quality to dilute the Claude
experience.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a product- and platform-led AI company with a safety-centered research identity. It commercializes Claude as an AI assistant for complex work, including analysis, coding, and problem-solving, while positioning reliability,
accuracy, security, interpretability, and steerability as core product attributes.

Its dominant enterprise motion is hybrid: direct product adoption is reinforced by an ecosystem of cloud, technology, and services partners. The company must preserve a coherent platform and trust posture while enabling many external
delivery organizations to configure, implement, and scale customer use cases.

The central operating challenge is not merely technical deployment. It is converting model capability into governed, repeatable enterprise adoption across business users, developers, administrators, and implementation partners.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic is a privately held AI public benefit corporation competing in a fast-moving frontier-model market where enterprise buyers evaluate both capability and deployment confidence. Its differentiation depends on making safety and
reliability legible in real production workflows, not only in research positioning.

Claude serves multiple adoption surfaces: an end-user assistant, enterprise offering, developer-facing capabilities, and coding workflows. That breadth creates pressure to align commercial messaging, technical architecture, security
expectations, administration, and change management around a consistent customer outcome.

Enterprise deployment guidance explicitly spans technical setup, launch and change management, enablement and training, and scaled adoption. This indicates that value realization depends on post-purchase operating discipline as much as
initial technical integration.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
The role’s stakeholder environment is likely shaped by several decision centers rather than a single commercial owner:

- Partnerships leaders need scalable partner coverage, joint account alignment, and clear rules for where Anthropic technical teams engage directly.
- Product and engineering stakeholders need high-quality field feedback that distinguishes reusable platform needs from partner-specific implementation requests.
- Enterprise administrators and customer technology leaders need deployable controls, adoption guidance, and a credible path from pilots to scaled use.
- Security, compliance, and governance stakeholders matter because Anthropic positions Claude for business use through security- and compliance-oriented enterprise capabilities.
- Cloud, technology, and services partners need enough technical enablement to deliver independently while remaining aligned to Anthropic’s product and safety expectations.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is positioned for knowledge work and technical work: analyzing data, writing code, and tackling complex problems. This makes the architecture conversation broader than model access; it includes workflow design, user adoption,
developer use cases, administration, and production operating practices.

Claude for Enterprise is supported by administrator guidance that includes technical setup and Claude Code seat configuration. That is a signal that enterprise architecture must connect workspace administration and user deployment with
developer-oriented usage rather than treating them as separate products.

Anthropic’s stated emphasis on reliable, interpretable, and steerable systems creates a practical architecture standard: partner-built solutions must be valuable enough to deploy while remaining aligned with customer expectations for
security, accuracy, and responsible use.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic explicitly maintains a network of cloud, technology, and services partners to address customer AI challenges. This supports a partner-led motion that is more substantial than referral sourcing: partners are positioned to help
customers operationalize Claude.

The ecosystem likely requires three linked motions:

- Cloud partners provide strategic infrastructure and market access routes for enterprise AI adoption.
- Technology partners extend Claude into adjacent workflows, applications, and customer environments.
- Services partners translate platform capabilities into implementation programs, change management, and industry-specific solutions.

The important scaling question is how quickly Anthropic can move partner knowledge from bespoke technical support into reusable solution patterns, enablement assets, and deployment practices. Partner technical teams become a force
multiplier only when their delivery quality is consistent enough to protect product credibility.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s current public materials emphasize enterprise deployment, administrator enablement, and sustained adoption alongside Claude’s broad product positioning. This indicates an operating shift from access to implementation depth:
customers need help moving from experimentation into managed, measurable use.

Competitive pressure in enterprise AI is increasingly shaped by implementation speed, developer adoption, security confidence, and ecosystem reach. For Anthropic, the urgency is to make partner delivery repeatable before customer
architectures and AI-platform preferences become entrenched around alternate model providers or cloud-native choices.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Scaled partner technical enablement across cloud, technology, and services ecosystems.
- Built repeatable architectures that convert AI pilots into governed production deployments.
- Balanced platform standardization with industry- or account-specific solution design.
- Connected pre-sales technical work to implementation readiness and long-term adoption.
- Created feedback loops from partner and customer deployments into product priorities.
- Led technical teams through ambiguous, high-growth ecosystem buildout.
- Positioned security, reliability, and responsible-use requirements as deployment enablers.
- Developed partner-facing technical content, reference patterns, and field training.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s enterprise guidance treats adoption as technical setup plus change management, enablement, and scale—not a one-time deployment.
- The partner opportunity appears to be converting a broad cloud, technology, and services network into consistent customer delivery capacity.
- Claude’s coverage of business work, data analysis, coding, and developer workflows raises the need for unified enterprise architecture patterns.
- A safety and reliability-led market position makes partner implementation quality strategically important, not merely operationally useful.
- The most relevant conversation is likely about reusable partner-delivered adoption motions rather than isolated AI demonstrations.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, achievements, leadership scope, technical depth, metrics, and outcomes must come from the governed resume/proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
